title: HoneycombTools
description: A bulk-breaking tool mod. Wrap any vanilla tool in honeycomb on a crafting table to get tools that break adjacent ores/dirt/logs in one swing. 4 tiers × 6 materials × 3 kinds = 72 tools.
body:
# HoneycombTools

Wrap any vanilla tool in honeycomb to get tools that break adjacent blocks in one swing. Hit an ore and the whole vein drops. Chop one log and the whole tree falls. Dig one block and the terrain levels itself.

## Features

- **72 tools** — 4 tiers × 6 materials × 3 kinds (Pickaxe/Shovel/Axe)
- **Mode toggle** — Adjacent, Tunnel (1×2), Surround (3×3), Logs+Leaves, OFF. Right-click in air or press `O`
- **Hanikamu Repair enchantment** — Restores durability over time (Levels I–III)
- **Honeycomb Villager** — Spawns naturally, trades tools for 16 iron ingots
- **Dedicated workstation** — Hanikamu Workstation block prevents accidental crafting
- **Unbreakable Supreme tier** — Slime-block mining speed, no durability cost
- **Mod ore support** — Auto-detects `#c:ores` and `#neoforge:ores` tags
- **Configurable** — Add custom blocks to bulk-break lists, change limits
- **English / Japanese** — Auto-switches based on client locale

## Requirements
### MainVersion
NeoForge 1.21.1

### Supported Versions
- NeoForge: 1.20.4 / 1.21 / 1.21.1-1.21.11
- Forge: 1.20.1
- Fabric: 1.20.1 / 1.21-1.21.11

### About the Fabric/Forge Version
The Fabric and Forge versions are scheduled to reach end-of-support with version 1.1.3.  
Minor bug fixes may still be provided.

## Companion Mod

**[FlyBee](https://modrinth.com/mod/flybee)** — Ride bees through the sky

## Required mod
Patchouli is not required, but it can be used to add a guidebook.
